title: A generator no component provides is refused by the engine when the interaction is added, not by the SDK.
why: behavioural spec 'generated' (ADR 0085): the SDK checks nothing about the generator. The engine asks each one once at 'add-interaction', and refuses a name no component provides with 'interaction-invalid' naming the node's 'generator', where it would otherwise serve the recorded value on every exchange.

interaction.description: an order whose token names a generator nothing provides
